subject: [PATCH v2 12/12] mm/collapse: implement MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch moves the implementation of MADV_COLLAPSE from khugepaged.c to madvise.c, where it belongs among other madvise operations. This change simplifies the code and removes unnecessary dependencies between the daemon's file and the syscall implementation. The !CONFIG_TRANSPARENT_HUGEPAGE stub is also moved along with the rest of the code. The MADV_COLLAPSE operation remains a caller of the interface used by khugepaged, so its functionality does not change.
